studentJourney.title: Think First
studentJourney.studentText: Fair sharing means both people get the same amount.

studentJourney.studentInstruction: Look at the circle and see how it becomes two equal parts.
studentJourney.content: A whole is one complete object. A circle is one whole shape. When we divide one whole circle into two equal parts, each part is called one half. We write one half as 1/2. The parts must be equal. If one part is bigger and the other part is smaller, the parts are not halves.

studentJourney.successCriteria: Learner understands that one half means one of two equal parts of a whole.
studentJourney.title: What Is One Half?
studentJourney.studentText: A whole is one complete object. A circle is one whole shape. When we divide one whole circle into two equal parts, each part is called one half. We write one half as 1/2. The parts must be equal. If one part is bigger and the other part is smaller, the parts are not halves.
studentJourney.owlText: A half means one out of two equal parts.

interaction.question: Tap next to see how a whole circle becomes one half.
interaction.prompt: Tap next to see how a whole circle becomes one half.
interaction.hint: A half needs two equal parts.

studentJourney.studentInstruction: Think of something round that can be shared equally between two people.
studentJourney.content: You can see halves when one chapati is shared equally between two children, one orange is cut into two equal pieces, or one circular paper is folded into two equal parts. When the two pieces are the same size, each piece is one half.

activities.prompt: Shade one half of the circle.

studentJourney.content: Which sentence correctly explains one half?

interactionSpec.question: Which sentence correctly explains one half?
options: One half is one of two equal parts of a whole.
One half is any small part of a whole.
One half is one of four equal parts of a whole.
One half is the biggest part of a whole.

feedbackSpec.correct: Correct. One half is one of two equal parts of a whole.
feedbackSpec.incorrect: Not quite. A half must be one of two equal parts.
feedbackSpec.hint: Look for the answer that mentions two equal parts.

studentJourney.studentInstruction: You have completed the lesson. Remember: a half is one of two equal parts.
studentJourney.content: Today you learned that a circle can be one whole, one whole can be divided into two equal parts, each equal part is one half, one half can be written as 1/2, and unequal parts are not halves.
